name: Central Error Monitoring & Alerting
description: Provides centralized error monitoring across all automation workflows by capturing failures and immediately notifying the operations team with detailed diagnostic information.
trigger: Triggered automatically when any linked workflow encounters an execution error or exception.
coreLogic: Captures workflow execution errors from any connected automation → Extracts error details including workflow name, execution URL, error message, stack trace, and last executed node → Sends formatted diagnostic email to operations team with all relevant troubleshooting information → Enables rapid incident response and workflow reliability monitoring.
businessContext: This is the operational backbone that enables FairTix to run automated business processes with confidence. Without centralized error monitoring, workflow failures would go unnoticed, causing silent business process breakdowns. The 40 executions indicate this system is actively catching and reporting automation failures across the organization. This reveals FairTix has a sophisticated automation infrastructure that requires operational monitoring — they're running business-critical automations that need immediate attention when they fail.
sideEffects: Creates email alerts in operations inbox
Generates audit trail of automation failures

impactProposal.reasoning: This workflow is the safety net for all other automations. Without it, business-critical workflow failures (customer notifications, payment processing, lead handling) would be invisible until customers complain or revenue is lost. The 15% failure rate across executions shows it's actively preventing silent automation failures that would otherwise damage customer experience and operations.

businessBrief: The operational safety net that transforms invisible automation failures into immediate alerts — enabling rapid response before customers or revenue are impacted.
timeSavingsEstimate: N/A — this is event-triggered incident response, not replacing manual work. However, enables ~15-30 minutes faster incident detection vs. discovering failures through customer complaints. Confidence: benchmark-based.
revenueImpactEstimate: Indirect but critical — prevents revenue loss by enabling rapid response to failed customer-facing automations. Each undetected failure could cost lost sales, damaged trust, or support escalations. Confidence: benchmark-based.
failureImpact: Operations team loses visibility into automation health. Critical workflow failures go unnoticed until customers complain about missing notifications, failed orders, or broken processes. Mean time to detection increases from minutes to hours or days. Customer experience degrades silently. Support volume spikes with issues that should have been caught automatically.
dataIn: Error trigger data from n8n platform including workflow execution context, error details, and failure metadata.
dataOut: Formatted error notifications to operations team with diagnostic information and execution URLs for troubleshooting.

technicalEvidence.errorHandling: No error handling configured — this workflow has no retryOnFail settings and no error workflow of its own. If this error workflow fails, there's no backup notification system.
technicalEvidence.versionCount: 38 iterations — heavily refined and actively maintained
keyFindings: 40 executions with 15% failure rate indicates active error monitoring across automation infrastructure
Email template includes execution URL, error stack trace, and last executed node — comprehensive diagnostic data
Single point of failure: no error handling on the error workflow itself
High version count (38) suggests this is a core operational tool that's been continuously refined
